tools.name: find_skill_by_capability
tools.title: Find skill by capability tag
tools.description: Find skills in the org registry that provide a given capability tag (dotted lowercase, e.g. 'invoice.extract' or 'po.match'). Returns a list of skill summaries; each summary includes the MCP binding the agent needs to call the underlying skill server. By default only returns published skills.

published_only.description: If true (default), only return skills whose lifecycle stage is 'published'.

tools.name: describe_skill
tools.title: Describe a skill in full
tools.description: Return the full manifest for a skill, including governance (RBAC, data classification), scoring (determinism, risk), preconditions, effects, and a 'payloadFiles' list of skill:// resource URIs (SKILL.md narrative, asset schemas, scripts). Read those resources on demand. Call this after find_skill_by_capability when you need to decide whether a skill is safe to use for the task at hand.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.title: List all capabilities in the org
tools.description: List every capability tag in the registry mapped to the skills that provide it. Use this for catalog discovery when you do not yet have a specific task in mind, or when you need to confirm a tag exists before calling find_skill_by_capability.

tools.name: query_ontology
tools.title: Traverse the skills + org ontology
tools.description: Walk the org's knowledge graph from a seed node along an edge type up to max_hops (capped at 5). Skill graph relations: DEPENDS_ON, PROVIDES, CONSUMES, PRODUCES, REQUIRES, CAUSES, SUPERSEDES. Stage F Phase 1 cross-domain relations: HAS_ROLE, MEMBER_OF, WORKED_ON, EMPLOYED, REQUIRED, SATISFIED_BY, HOLDS_SKILL, COMPLETED, GRANTS, HOLDS_CERT. Seeds can be a skill id ('legal/msa-redlining'), capability tag ('docx.create'), or a cross-domain id ('person/eng-042', 'project/finance-rfp-001', 'cert/aws-sap'). Returns ranked paths with per-hop data-classification so callers can see governance scope. Pass caller_classification (public|internal|confidential|restricted) to gate paths above your clearance. Pass node_type_filter to restrict terminal node types (e.g. ['Skill'] when walking from a Person to surface only the skills they can reach).

seed.description: Seed node id — skill id ('legal/msa-redlining'), capability tag ('docx.create'), or cross-domain id ('person/eng-042', 'project/finance-rfp-001', 'training/python-async', 'cert/aws-sap').

relation.description: Edge type to traverse. Omit for any relation.

caller_classification.description: Caller's data clearance. Paths whose max classification exceeds this are suppressed. Default 'internal'.

node_type_filter.description: Optional list of node types to keep at the terminal of each path. E.g. ['Skill'] from a Person seed returns only Skill endpoints. Allowed: Skill, Capability, DataType, Condition, Person, Project, Training, Certification, Role, Team.

tools.name: list_org_entities
tools.title: List cross-domain entities (people, projects, training, certs)
tools.description: Stage F Phase 1 discovery helper. Returns summaries for entities in the cross-domain ontology so an agent can pick a seed before calling query_ontology. Read-only, paginated. Use this to find a Person id before walking to their skills, or a Project id before walking to its required capabilities.

limit.description: Maximum number of summaries to return. Default 50, capped at 200.
